title: Priyansh Arya Smashes 181 Off 68 Balls, the Second-Highest Score in T20 History
excerpt: The Delhi captain's 19 sixes equalled the world record for a T20 innings as Delhi posted 275 for 5 and beat Tamil Nadu by 116 runs in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy in Indore.
body:
• Delhi captain Priyansh Arya scored 181 off 68 balls against Tamil Nadu in Indore — the highest T20 score by an Indian and the second-highest in men's T20 history.
  • His 19 sixes equalled Finn Allen's world record for a T20 innings; his fifty took 18 balls, his century 36, and his 150 a tournament-record 60.
  • Delhi posted 275 for 5, the joint third-highest total in Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy history, and won by 116 runs as Tamil Nadu were bowled out for 159.
  • Arya finished seven runs short of Lhuan-dre Pretorius's world record of 188 not out, passing Chris Gayle's 175 not out on the way.

Priyansh Arya produced the highest innings by an Indian in Twenty20 cricket on Tuesday, scoring 181 off 68 balls to carry Delhi to a 116-run win over Tamil Nadu in their Elite Group B fixture of the 2026-27 Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy at the Daly College Ground in Indore. Tamil Nadu, chasing 276, were bowled out for 159 in 18.3 overs.

The innings

Asked to bat, Delhi made 94 for 1 in the powerplay, with Arya reaching his fifty in 18 balls — eight of his sixes came in the first six overs, according to reports. The 25-year-old left-hander brought up his third T20 century in 36 balls and crossed 150 in 60 balls, the fastest 150 in the tournament's history. A 118-run second-wicket stand with Nitish Rana kept the innings moving, though no other Delhi batter crossed 30. Arya hit M Siddharth for a four and a six off successive balls to pass Chris Gayle's 175 not out, and was dismissed by the same bowler in the 19th over, caught by Rithik Easwaran, seven runs short of the world record.

The records

The BCCI's record list from the match is long. The 181 is the highest score in Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy history, passing Tilak Varma's 151 for Hyderabad against Meghalaya in 2024; the highest T20 score by an Indian, passing KL Rahul's 152 not out in the IPL and Kiran Navgire's 162, the previous highest by any Indian across men's and women's cricket; and the highest individual score by a captain in T20 history, passing Aaron Finch's 172. His 19 sixes equalled Finn Allen's world record for a men's T20 innings and set a new tournament mark, and his 150 came up in 60 balls against the previous record of 66. Only South Africa's Lhuan-dre Pretorius, who made 188 not out for the Titans last month, has scored more in a men's T20 innings.

What it means

Delhi's 275 for 5 is the joint third-highest total in the tournament's history, behind Baroda's 349 for 5 and Punjab's 310 for 5. ESPNcricinfo noted that Delhi have batted first in each of their matches this season and scored at least 200 in five of six innings; their only defeat came in the one match they did not, against Saurashtra. Arya, retained by Punjab Kings ahead of the IPL 2027 auction, was among the fastest-scoring openers in IPL 2026. The league stage is in its sixth round, with the top two teams from each elite group advancing to the Super League stage.
